procedures.name: CheckGLAcc
procedures.doc: Validates that the specified G/L account exists and is properly configured for VAT posting.

procedures.name: TestNotSalesTax
procedures.doc: Validates that the specified field is not used when VAT Calculation Type is Sales Tax. Prevents configuration of VAT fields that are incompatible with Sales Tax calculation method.

procedures.name: GetSalesAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate sales VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized sales VAT account with validation for required account setup.

procedures.name: GetPurchAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate purchase VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized purchase VAT account with validation for required account setup.

procedures.name: GetRevChargeAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate reverse charge VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized reverse charge VAT account for EU and domestic reverse charge transactions.

procedures.name: SetAccountsVisibility
procedures.doc: Sets visibility flags for unrealized VAT and payment discount adjustment based on General Ledger Setup configuration. Controls UI field visibility for VAT posting setup pages based on system-wide VAT settings.

procedures.name: SuggestSetupAccounts
procedures.doc: Suggests G/L account assignments for VAT posting setup based on existing similar setups and account patterns. Provides automated account suggestion functionality to streamline VAT posting setup configuration.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetPurchAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before retrieving purchase VAT account to allow custom account selection logic. Enables extensions to override standard purchase VAT account determination based on custom business rules.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetSalesAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before retrieving sales VAT account to allow custom account selection logic. Enables extensions to override standard sales VAT account determination based on custom business rules.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckSetupUsage
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking VAT posting setup usage to allow custom validation logic. Enables extensions to perform additional validation or override standard setup usage checks.

procedures.name: InsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Inserts or updates a detailed CV ledger entry buffer record with consolidation logic. Combines entries with matching key fields to avoid duplicate buffer records.

procedures.name: CopyPostingGroupsFromVATEntry
procedures.doc: Copies posting group fields from a VAT entry to the detailed CV ledger entry buffer. Used for VAT-related detailed entries to maintain proper posting setup references.

procedures.name: CopyFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Copies relevant fields from a general journal line to create an initial detailed CV ledger entry. Sets up the buffer with transaction amounts, dimensions, and basic posting information.

procedures.name: InitFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Initializes the detailed CV ledger entry buffer with basic posting information from a general journal line. Sets up document and user identification fields without amounts or detailed data.

procedures.name: CopyFromCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Copies key reference fields from a CV ledger entry buffer to establish parent-child relationship. Links the detailed entry to its parent ledger entry with currency and dimension information.

procedures.name: InitDetailedCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Initializes and inserts a complete detailed CV ledger entry buffer with specified amounts and application data. Creates fully populated detailed entry for payment applications, discounts, and tolerance scenarios.

procedures.name: FindVATEntry
procedures.doc: Finds the corresponding VAT entry for the detailed CV ledger entry using transaction number and posting groups. Used to link detailed entries with their related VAT transactions for reporting and analysis.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying fields from a general journal line to the detailed CV ledger entry buffer. Enables customization of field mapping and additional data population from journal lines.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying reference fields from a CV ledger entry buffer. Enables customization of field mapping and additional data population from parent ledger entries.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyPostingGroupsFromVATEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying posting groups from a VAT entry. Enables customization of VAT-related posting group assignments and validation.

procedures.name: OnAfterInitFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after initializing basic fields from a general journal line. Enables customization of initialization logic and additional field setup.

procedures.name: OnAfterInsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after inserting a detailed CV ledger entry buffer record. Enables post-processing of inserted detailed entries and related buffer updates.

procedures.name: OnBeforeInsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a detailed CV ledger entry buffer in the initialization process. Enables custom validation and processing before detailed entry creation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCreateDtldCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before creating a detailed CV ledger entry buffer during consolidation. Enables custom logic for entry consolidation and duplicate detection.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeInsert
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a new detailed CV ledger entry buffer record. Enables final validation and field modifications before database insertion.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying an existing detailed CV ledger entry buffer during consolidation. Enables custom logic for amount aggregation and field updates in consolidated entries.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeNewDtldCVLedgEntryBufInit
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before initializing a new detailed CV ledger entry buffer during the insertion process. Enables custom setup and field population before detailed entry processing begins.
